scripts.description: Phase 3: Think tank debate with external research strategies

key_findings.current_bottleneck: Single-item work stealing with BEGIN IMMEDIATE spends 2.77-3.36x more time on steal transactions than on actual work
key_findings.root_cause: SQLite serialization in the hot path - workers contend on every item
key_findings.universal_principle: Move work distribution out of SQLite into in-memory structures. All top strategies (9-11x improvement) avoid SQLite in the hot path.

recommended_implementation.immediate: Add steal_batch(n) method to WorkStealing class (4.7x improvement, no architecture change)
recommended_implementation.structural: Implement hierarchical LeadDistributor with in-memory queue (10.4x improvement)
recommended_implementation.future: Go-style three-tier (local → global → steal) for sub-ms scheduling latency
